# telnyx_managed_account (Resource)

A managed account: a separate Telnyx account that this manager account creates and administers. The API cannot delete managed accounts: destroy removes it from Terraform state, and the telnyx_managed_account_disable action disables it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The API cannot delete managed accounts: destroy only removes this one from
# Terraform state.
resource "telnyx_managed_account" "reseller" {
  business_name  = "Acme Reseller"
  email          = "telecom@reseller.example.com"
  rollup_billing = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `business_name` (String) The name of the business for which the new managed account is being created, that will be used as the managed accounts's organization's name. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.

### Optional

- `channel_limit` (Number) Integer value that indicates the number of allocatable global outbound channels that should be allocated to the managed account. Must be 0 or more. If the value is 0 then the account will have no usable channels and will not be able to perform outbound calling. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `email` (String) The managed account's email.
- `managed_account_allow_custom_pricing` (Boolean) Boolean value that indicates if the managed account is able to have custom pricing set for it or not. If false, uses the pricing of the manager account. Defaults to false. There may be time lag between when the value is changed and pricing changes take effect.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for the managed account. If a password is not supplied, the account will not be able to be signed into directly. (A password reset may still be performed later to enable sign-in via password.) The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `rollup_billing` (Boolean) Boolean value that indicates if the billing information and charges to the managed account "roll up" to the manager account. If true, the managed account will not have its own balance and will use the shared balance with the manager account. This value cannot be changed after account creation without going through Telnyx support as changes require manual updates to the account ledger. Defaults to false.

### Read-Only

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) The managed account's V2 API access key
- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) The managed account's V1 API token
- `api_user` (String) The manager account's email, which serves as the V1 API user identifier
- `balance` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--balance))
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was created.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the managed account.
- `manager_account_id` (String) The ID of the manager account associated with the managed account.
- `organization_name` (String) The organization the managed account is associated with.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was updated.

<a id="nestedatt--balance"></a>
### Nested Schema for `balance`

Read-Only:

- `available_credit` (String) Available amount to spend (balance + credit limit)
- `balance` (String) The account's current balance.
- `credit_limit` (String) The account's credit limit.
- `currency` (String) The ISO 4217 currency identifier.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_managed_account.example <id>
```
